Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Top UN court finds Myanmar committed genocide against Muslim Rohingya

blocks.text: The International Court of Justice or ICJ rules Thursday, November 19, Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims in Northern Rakhine State in 2017.

items: How many workers does Sara-linked firm Cale88 have? Records don’t match.

blocks.text: Cale88, the company originally owned by Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, Mans Carpio, comes under scrutiny again with questions emerging about its workforce.

items: Sara Duterte spox accuse senators of bias, told to explain

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court orders Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Paolo Panelo, to explain his remarks accusing senator-judges of undermining the credibility of a defense witness.

items: Trump, Xi, Putin release ‘peace declaration’ from unprecedented summit

blocks.text: The US, China, and Russia agree on a symbolic ‘peace declaration’ at an unprecedented three-way summit in Shenzhen, China.

items: Viral hippo Fiona dies after ingesting a hat
